data.action: 靠在丝绒包厢护栏单手支颐，微侧头凝望
data.animaCaption: Resting her cheek in one hand along the gilded railing of a crimson velvet opera box, she gazes across the shadowed auditorium with a faint, melancholic smile.
data.camera: 中近景，微仰拍包厢视角
data.description: 金箔雕花的二层猩红天鹅绒歌剧包厢内，弗洛洛身着黑蕾丝袖丝绒晚礼服，单手支颐靠在包厢护栏上，低垂眼帘俯瞰空荡观众席。
data.lighting: 包厢壁灯暖琥珀光与舞台暗红余晖
data.location: 歌剧院二层猩红天鹅绒包厢
data.promptProse: Framed by heavy crimson velvet drapes inside a gilded opera box, Phrolova leans on the balustrade in an off-shoulder velvet gown with black Chantilly lace sleeves, gazing quietly into the dusk.
data.title: 弗洛洛 · 猩红天鹅绒歌剧包厢凭栏俯瞰
